description: Start a DIRECT UPLOAD of one file (up to 1 GB) to a work item, initiative or program. Returns `uploadUrl`, a one-time Storage URL that accepts exactly `size` bytes for 24 hours, and a `curl` command that sends them. After the PUT succeeds, call anyforge_complete_file_upload with the `uploadId`; the file is not attached until then. Accepted: images, video, PDF, Office documents, text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, XML, logs, HAR captures and zip; the extension decides the type. On a work item the file is added INTERNAL. When a file with the same name and size is already on the record, the answer is { alreadyAttached: true, file } and there is nothing to upload; a same-name file of another size is refused (file_name_exists, 409) unless onNameConflict is "keep_both". Requires `write` scope and an Editor or above. On the local (stdio) server, anyforge_upload_local_file does all three steps for a file on disk.

id.description: The work item, initiative or program id.

mediaType.description: Optional MIME type; the extension wins when they disagree.

name.description: File name with its extension, e.g. "repro.mp4".

onNameConflict.description: A same-name file of a different size already on the record: refuse it (default, file_name_exists) or attach both. A same-name, same-size file is never attached twice.

originalCreatedAt.description: Optional. When the file was created in the tool it came from: an ISO 8601 date or a date and time with a zone, e.g. 2024-03-01T10:22:33.000+0000. Kept beside the upload time.

size.description: Exact size in bytes. The upload URL accepts exactly this many.

target.description: The kind of record the file is attached to.

name: anyforge_start_file_upload
title: Start file upload
